Twelve actual key events join echo parse, render command, animation-frame identity and AnimationFrame::Presentation.

All twelve selected main-entry animation-frame identities have zero matching presentation feedback. The windows contain 17 and 14 presentation events for other identities. Exact error: Terminal frame requires positive Chrome presentation feedback; capture timing is not a fallback.
channels.nextProbe: Investigate how Linux compositor feedback maps to the selected terminal animation-frame IDs. Do not substitute screenshot time.

channels.reason: Both ABBA worker arms on each host fail with: Terminal render requires a containing animation frame. The current join cannot place the worker render span inside a Chrome AnimationFrame event.
channels.nextProbe: Implement and validate a worker-aware render-command-to-compositor-frame identity join.

channels.reason: checks.mjs samples() sends only keyboard input and creates only operation=input captures. It does not run the existing comparison runner ordinary-write presentation endpoint. No new ordinary-write trace was acquired.
channels.nextProbe: Acquire operation=write captures with the existing endpoint; the PC feedback-identity failure remains a separate dependency.

channels.reason: The new worker probe also creates input captures only. There is no operation=write capture to join, and the worker containing-frame join separately fails in the input experiment.

channels.reason: CDP attaches directly to worker targets and calls Runtime.getHeapUsage, independently of the main-page heap.

Twenty-four PC arms use the same producer port with clone/transfer/transfer/clone order across both backends and three buffer sizes. Each arm has 24 contiguous parse acknowledgements and parser calls. Clone buffers remain readable; transferred buffers detach. Text hashes and submissions match within each four-arm group. This is a bounded owned-buffer diagnostic, not the full workload matrix.

No Mac review cohort was launched because bounded availability checks found active reservations: first F2 process 81117, then X7 publication process 83046. AC power and owner availability pass, but these job locks prohibit a concurrent headed acquisition. Original evidence does not cover this channel.
channels.nextProbe: Acquire the Mac job lock after the active lane releases it, then run review-probes.mjs on that host.

channels.reason: The existing probe records sent/acknowledged counts, maximum pending writes and eight key-to-echo acknowledgements. Pending writes peak at one on the PC and one/two on the Mac; the offered rate does not create a growing backlog. It is not an overload measurement.
channels.nextProbe: Add a bounded rate sweep until backlog grows, then record queue drain and input responsiveness. Presented input needs the separate M2 busy-window trace.

channels.reason: The operation is timed through the next actual terminal onFrame event. Resource and heap endpoints are retained; this is submission, not presentation or peak memory.
The existing ABBA probe times device loss through the next submitted frame and records deviceRestores/resource snapshots. The original snapshots omit adapter metadata.

Fresh main and worker WebGPU devices after loss expose vendor=nvidia, architecture=ampere and fallback=false before and after; Chromium exposes empty device/description strings. WebGL worker recovery retains current NVIDIA/RTX 3060 Ti vendor/renderer. Main WebGL after-recovery metadata is absent because its first snapshot queried an extension during loss and failed. The diagnostic now checks lost-context state first, but the recovery-only rerun never launched: shared-runner quiet admission expired at 600 seconds. Equal exposed metadata does not establish a physical GPU serial identity.
channels.nextProbe: Requeue P0A_REVIEW_PHASES=recovery P0A_REVIEW_RUN=recovery- when a PC quiet slot is available; verify main WebGL metadata after the restored submission.

channels.reason: PC worker WebGL loss/restore reaches a submitted frame in 116.9ms including the explicit 100ms restore delay, with one restore and the same exposed NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti renderer. Main WebGL first failed an extension query during loss. Its diagnostic guard is fixed, but the recovery-only rerun was not acquired because quiet admission expired at 600 seconds. The Mac cohort was not acquired because other lanes held its lock.
channels.nextProbe: Requeue the guarded PC recovery probe and acquire the Mac main/worker context-loss cohort when each host reservation is available.
